req.title: Create form GET returns 200
req.statement: The system shall serve the create-post form at GET /create for authenticated users.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-038 requires GET /create to return HTTP 200 for authenticated users. Three test cases are needed: (1) positive — authenticated user gets 200; (2) negative — unauthenticated user is redirected (not 200); (3) boundary — state transition from unauthenticated to authenticated then GET /create returns exactly 200. Each test uses in-process Flask test client, exact status code assertions, and real credentials from the pre-loaded dataset.

tests.name: test_create_get_authenticated_returns_200
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Database contains user id=1 username=Rahul password=stone (pre-loaded)
User is logged in via POST /auth/login
expected: Response body contains the create form HTML
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_create_get_authenticated_returns_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert login_r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/create')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'create' in r.data.lower() or b'form' in r.data.lower() or b'title' in r.data.lower()

test_create_get_authenticated_returns_200()

tests.name: test_create_get_unauthenticated_redirects_not_200
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
No user is logged in (fresh session)
expected: Response status is 302 (redirect to login), NOT 200
trace: R-FLASKR-038: only authenticated users get 200; unauthenticated must be redirected
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_create_get_unauthenticated_redirects_not_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/create')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 200
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/auth/login' in location

test_create_get_unauthenticated_redirects_not_200()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_create_get_after_login_logout_login_returns_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r0 = client.get('/create')
    assert r0.status_code == 302
    assert r0.status_code != 200
    r1 = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    r2 = client.get('/create')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    r3 = client.get('/auth/logout')
    assert r3.status_code == 302
    r4 = client.get('/create')
    assert r4.status_code == 302
    assert r4.status_code != 200
    r5 = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})
    assert r5.status_code == 302
    r6 = client.get('/create')
    assert r6.status_code == 200

test_create_get_after_login_logout_login_returns_200()
